name: @singularity/plugin-primitives-css-rail
description: The rail contract: padding is the act of opening a region, and the region publishes where its contents' edge is as --rail-start / --rail-end / --rail-block-start / --rail-block-end. This plugin owns the four var names; the utilities that publish them (rail-<step>, rail-bleed, rail-follow) live in ui-kit's app.css.
